title: Xiaomi MIUI 10.3 (Android 9.1) FS + Miaomiao 1 missed connection
body:
Hi all. I'm desperate, my old phone battery is almost died, so I urgently bought a Xiaomi Note 7, with MIUI 10.3, basicly Android 9.1.
I tried to connect a new Freestyle sensor via Miaomiao 1 to xDrip+ 06 Oct release, and MM was seen by the phone, but it did not connect to it.
I tried the "Bluetooth Pairing", too, noway.
Please someone tell me if it's a mistake of mine, or if this OS gives problems.
Thanks a lot, you are my saviours
Pippo    :-)

comments.body:
Hi, today i have got my new miaomiao2. I am using libre2 (14 Days Europe) Sensors.
On my Xiaomi MiMix2s I also cannot use xdrip+.
Tomato-APP works fine, connects to the transmitter and just reading the sensor.
Xdrip+, nightly 20191008 connects to the transmitter, but cant find sensor.
I am still waiting :-)

There can only be bugs in the system that affect the disconnection of the authorized Miaomiao.
I have a special procedure for connecting MM to the phone again or to replace the sensor.
1. In Xdrip "--- >> Stop Sensor >> STOP SENSOR"
2. Charges batteries in MM
3. Resets MM with the micro button
3. Rebooot your smartphone with Xdrip
4. In Xdrip "--- >> START SENSOR"
5. Waiting for 3 measurements (15 minutes) with MM or longer when I took a new sensor
6. calibrates Libra readings with blood glucose meter

I recommend updating the Xiaomi rom to the latest beta version from miuipolska.pl, because they sometimes put in them bluetooth driver patches for our smartphone processor.

I used to have problems resuming connection on MM 1 and Samsung Glaxy S6, then it helped to update Xdrip to the latest alpha version directly from github -> https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases .

Hi mustang011. 
Thank you for the info, even if I doubt I'll be able to update Xiaomi rom using miuipolska.pl beta version. 
I'll try, anyway.
BTW, I just discovered that my phone, as a ton of other Xiaomi phones, is going to be updated shortly to MIUI 11, so may be better to wait and check if the new MIUI will solve or not this problem, do you agree?
Bye
Pippo     :-)

Just as you write. The rom from muipolska.pl is better than the original global, because it does not contain ads. You have to get tired to unlock the possibility of flashing another rom and you lose the phone tracking system in case of theft from xaomi. In my Xaomi Mi 8 the upgrade to beta rom solved problems with bluetooth. I am happy with the new mui 11 and I am sure that the newer rom will help you too.
